paper_metadata.title: Otter: A Multi-Modal Model with In-Context Instruction Tuning
paper_metadata.abstract:
Recent advances in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have unveiled great potential as visual assistants. However, most existing works focus on responding to individual instructions or using previous dialogues for contextual understanding. There is little discussion on employing both images and text as in-context examples to enhance the instruction following capability.
  To bridge this gap, we introduce the \textbf{Otter} model to leverage both textual and visual in-context examples for instruction tuning. Specifically, Otter builds upon Flamingo with Perceiver architecture, and has been instruction tuned for general purpose multi-modal assistant. Otter seamlessly processes multi-modal inputs, supporting modalities including text, multiple images, and dynamic video content. To support the training of Otter, we present the \textbf{MIMIC-IT} (\textbf{M}ult\textbf{I}-\textbf{M}odal \textbf{I}n-\textbf{C}ontext \textbf{I}nstruction \textbf{T}uning) dataset, which encompasses over 3 million multi-modal instruction-response pairs, including approximately 2.2 million unique instructions across a broad spectrum of images and videos. MIMIC-IT has been carefully curated to feature a diverse array of in-context examples for each entry.
  Comprehensive evaluations suggest that instruction tuning with these in-context examples substantially enhances model convergence and generalization capabilities. Notably, the extensive scenario coverage provided by the MIMIC-IT dataset empowers the Otter model to excel in tasks involving complex video and multi-image understanding.

extraction_data.innovation: In-context instruction tuning: precisely controlling the response format in instruction tuning data to significantly enhance benchmark performance across tasks requiring binary yes/no answers and general instruction following, improving upon prior multi-modal models that lack format control; ChatGPT-based data correction: feeding samples into ChatGPT to repeat queries and obtain accurate, usable answers, with invalid samples documented and excluded during dataset iteration to ensure high-quality instruction tuning data.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: Obelics, COCO, Visual Genome, OK-VQA, and other web-scale image-text datasets
extraction_data.finetuning_task: In-context instruction tuning, Visual instruction tuning, Visual instruction tuning with in-context examples
extraction_data.extension: Uses a perceiver resampler to convert image/video features into a fixed set of visual tokens, which condition language layers via cross-gated attention modules.
extraction_data.research_problem: Instruction following and contextual understanding in multimodal models
extraction_data.application: Visual instruction tuning, image and video understanding, scene navigation, visual storytelling, dense captioning
extraction_data.paper_title: Otter: A Multi-Modal Model with In-Context Instruction Tuning
extraction_data.finetuning_data: MIMIC-IT (MultI-Modal In-Context Instruction Tuning) dataset, MIMIC-IT dataset, VG, VQAv2, GQA, OKVQA, OCRVQA, A-OKVQA, TextQA, RefCOCO, COCO-ITM, ImageNet, ImageNet-Paragraphs, M3ITCollection, MIMIC-IT
extraction_data.hardware_description: Peak GPU memory ~70G (Image), ~76G (Video); Batch size 4-8 per GPU
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Perceiver architecture, Multi-head self-attention, Multi-head self-attention (OPT backbone)
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Upstream image-text interleaved pretraining (inherited from Flamingo) -> In-context instruction tuning
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: ChatGPT-based query repetition and error correction
extraction_data.vision_encoder: low-res (224x224) pretrained vision encoder, CLIP ViT-L/14
extraction_data.benchmark_result: MSVD-QA: 77.9; MSRVTT-QA: 68.4; ActivityNet-QA: 68.5; MME-Cog: 1415.7; MM-Vet: 27.0; MME-Cog: 1212.9 (0-shot), 1310.7 (2-shot), 1173.5 (4-shot) without ICIT; 1227.7 (0-shot), 1430.3 (2-shot), 1397.8 (4-shot) with 2-shot ICIT; 1277.8 (0-shot), 1387.9 (2-shot), 1440.8 (4-shot) with 4-shot ICIT; SOTA on VQAv2, GQA, OK-VQA, and Visual Genome at time of publication
